physical_definition: Use the modeled sea-level-equivalent temperature smoothed by a fixed500km Gaussian, minus half the existing column lapse times the representative height. Its horizontal gradient approximates a common-height layer-mean gradient under a uniform-lapse assumption. Add du=-gH*inverse_f*dlog(T)/dnorth, dv=gH*inverse_f*dlog(T)/deast to moisture flow only. Smooth inverse_f=f/(f^2+f10^2), f10=Earth Coriolis at10degrees, is an explicit equatorial validity taper, not an equatorial dynamical solution. Shear aloft does not receive empirical surface mountain drag. Surface momentum, heat transport, evaporation and terrain lift retain surface winds. This is an idealized effective layer, not resolved vertical continuity, a prognostic momentum/energy budget, or measured full-column moisture flux. Planet parameters stay fixed Earth-like.
